title: Archaeal NusA2 is the ancestor of ribosomal protein eS7 in eukaryotes.
authors: Phung, Duy Khanh; Pilotto, Simona; Matelska, Dorota; Blombach, Fabian; Pinotsis, Nikos; Hovan, Ladislav; Gervasio, Francesco Luigi; Werner, Finn
one_liner_zh: 该文研究古菌NusA2蛋白的晶体结构与RNA结合机制，虽涉及蛋白-核酸互作和分子动力学模拟，但对象为蛋白-RNA而非蛋白-DNA，且非TF-DNA体系，仅方法可部分借鉴。
abstract: N-utilization substance A (NusA) is a regulatory factor with pleiotropic functions in gene expression in bacteria. Archaea encode two conserved small proteins, NusA1 and NusA2, with domains orthologous to the two RNA binding K Homology (KH) domains of NusA. Here, we report the crystal structures of NusA2 from Sulfolobus acidocaldarius and Saccharolobus solfataricus obtained at 3.1 A and 1.68 A, respectively. NusA2 comprises an N-terminal zinc finger followed by two KH-like domains lacking the GXXG signature. Despite the loss of the GXXG motif, NusA2 binds single-stranded RNA. Mutations in the zinc finger domain compromise the structural integrity of NusA2 at high temperatures and molecular dynamics simulations indicate that zinc binding provides an energy barrier preventing the domain from reaching unfolded states. A structure-guided phylogenetic analysis of the KH-like domains supports the notion that the NusA2 clade is ancestral to the ribosomal protein eS7 in eukaryotes, implying a potential role of NusA2 in translation.
abstract_zh: N-利用物质A（NusA）是一种在细菌基因表达中具有多效性功能的调控因子。古菌编码两种保守的小蛋白，NusA1和NusA2，其结构域与NusA的两个RNA结合K同源（KH）结构域直系同源。在此，我们报道了来自Sulfolobus acidocaldarius和Saccharolobus solfataricus的NusA2晶体结构，分别以3.1 Å和1.68 Å的分辨率获得。NusA2包含一个N端锌指结构域，随后是两个缺乏GXXG特征序列的KH样结构域。尽管失去了GXXG基序，NusA2仍能结合单链RNA。锌指结构域中的突变在高温下损害了NusA2的结构完整性，分子动力学模拟表明，锌结合提供了一个能量屏障，防止该结构域达到未折叠状态。对KH样结构域的结构引导系统发育分析支持NusA2分支是真核生物核糖体蛋白eS7的祖先这一观点，暗示NusA2在翻译中可能具有潜在作用。
